propositions: Closing a bug ticket emits spurious 'Ambiguous prefix' errors on stderr for bare 4-hex commit-subject fragments and hangs the CLI for minutes after the close durably commits.

The post-close metrics.blame._find_fixing_commit loop re-resolves the bug_id per commit without caching or quiet mode, causing O(commits × tickets) alias-file scanning that takes ~9 minutes on a 2137-commit history.
Bare 4-hex fragments in commit subjects are incorrectly resolved as ticket references during caused-by derivation, though they are not supported citation forms per operator decision.

The resolution scanner is called without quiet=True at multiple call sites (_resolves_to, _commit_ticket, derive_caused_by self-comparison), violating the existing quiet-resolution seam documented in _ids.py for candidates users never supplied.

Four changes (quiet=True on all scanner calls, hoist loop-invariant bug_id resolution, memoize ref resolutions, and short-circuit non-matching hex-quad shapes) eliminate terminal noise and reduce caused-by derivation from ~9 minutes to 0.06s without altering which id forms resolve.
